comment: ASSET (Alva-Manchego et al., ACL 2020, doi:10.18653/v1/2020.acl-main.424). GitHub: https://github.com/facebookresearch/asset. HuggingFace mirror facebook/asset. Same English Wikipedia originals as TurkCorpus with 10 higher-quality references per sentence; we sample one reference per original (seeded by a stable hash of the original sentence) to form a length-2 simple->complex ordered pair.
